title: Cairo 2023-04-28 01:30:00
why: the first summer-time hour after Egypt reintroduced DST

ephemeris.calc_flags: SEFLG_SWIEPH | SEFLG_SPEED | SEFLG_SIDEREAL (+ SEFLG_TOPOCTR when topocentric)

conventions.angles: degrees, f64 as computed, no rounding; sidereal unless named tropical
conventions.instants: Julian Day in UT (UT1 as the library defines it); dates as ISO-8601 UTC strings
conventions.house: 1 to 12, whole-sign from the Lagna sign unless named
conventions.classification: decimal.js division of the f64 longitude, floor, lower-inclusive boundaries

settings_hash.algorithm: sha256 of the canonical string, first 16 hex characters
